Hi Elena — thanks for sending the bank details and W-9. A couple of notes and next steps from procurement/ops: 

1) Bank-proof: our payments team requires either a voided check or a bank letter on company letterhead confirming account/routing (bank letter preferred). Please upload the bank letter to the Drive folder linked below or attach it to a reply.

2) Remittance format: Redwood prefers the PO number to be included in the remittance/reference string so our payables engine can auto-apply. Best practice we ask partners to follow: "PO:{po_number}" as a discrete token (example: "PO:12345678 INV:202712001"). If you can include that token in your outbound reference that will avoid manual reconciliation.

3) CSV: Ben has a small template (headers + example row) — I'll ask him to share. If you can return one sample export with a row mapping for the invoice/PO fields, we can validate parity before live payments.

Action items:
- Elena: upload bank letter (PDF) and a 1-row CSV export showing an example remittance.
- Ben: share remit_csv_template.csv + confirm micro-deposit vs. immediate ACH test.

Jordan Blake
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
(jordan.blake@redwood.run)

Thanks Elena — I'll own the finance side. Quick checklist from Payments: 

- Bank-proof (bank letter on letterhead OR voided check).
- W-9 matching legal name (the W-9 you sent shows "Lumenix Inc." — confirm this is the legal name used on invoices).
- We perform micro-deposits for ACH validation (two small deposits under $0.50) OR we can run an immediate low-value test wire if you prefer. Let us know which you prefer; ACH micro-deposit is the default and typically faster to clear.

I've attached our remit CSV template (remit_csv_template.csv). CSV header expectation: 
"remit_id,invoice_number,invoice_date,amount,currency,po_reference,payable_to,remit_notes"
Sample row we expect: 
"RMT-20271220,INV-202712001,2027-12-01,12500.00,USD,PO:12345678,Lumenix Inc.,\"Invoice for December work; please apply PO:12345678\""

If you can return a single-row CSV mapped to these headers we'll validate on our side and confirm the mapping to the AP system.

Attachments: remit_csv_template.csv (CSV template)
